brief: New Deal Colonial Revival post office of 1938-39: one storey of red brick over a high basement on a hillside street, side-gabled with a white cupola-less cornice, tall 9/9 windows, a fanlit entrance reached by two long flights of iron-railed steps, and a Treasury cornerstone; a flagpole and blue collection box on the sidewalk.

facade.notes: the Pomeroy OH post office (1938-39): one tall storey of red brick over a high basement on the Ohio River hillside, a low slate hip roof, tall 6-over-6 windows, a fanlit centre door reached by twin curving stairs with iron rails; angle parking in front, a wooded bluff behind

why.note: a civic building is a raised, symmetric block set apart by steps, lawn and a portico
the New Deal post office: Treasury standard plans in a restrained Colonial Revival, 1934-43
